The '''Alzarians''' were a [[Species/Legends|species]] of green-skinned [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoids]] was indigenous to the [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Alzar]], in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].

==History==
During the [[Galactic War]] in [[3637 BBY]] [[Dark Council]] member [[Darth Ravage]] rapidly expanded into Alzarian territory, believing them to hold no value. [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]] [[Overseer (Sith)|Overseers]] loyal to [[Darth Nox]] believed the Alzarians could be trained as [[Sith/Legends|Sith]], but were cautious to recruit them so as not to make an enemy of Ravage.<ref name="SWTOR">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Shadow of Revan]]''</ref>

By the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Period]], they were ruled over by [[King/Legends|King]] [[Gokus]]. [[General/Legends|General]] [[Sludd]] attempted to usurp the throne, tricking the heir [[Prince/Legends|Prince]] [[Plooz]] into running away to the rival world of [[Sooma]]. Plooz was rescued by [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] and [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]], but while taking him home, they were shot down by Sludd over the forest moon of [[Endor/Legends|Endor]].<ref name="Droids 4" /> The [[Droid/Legends|droids]] eventually did get Plooz safely home, and Sludd's plans were thwarted.<ref name="Ewoks 10">[[Ewoks (1985) 10|''Ewoks'' (1985) 10]]</ref>

Ten months after the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], many of them were killed in the [[Stenax Massacres]], when the [[Stenax]] used stolen [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] weapons to invade the planet.<ref name="G1">{{GamerCite|1|The University of Sanbra Guide to Intelligent Life: The Marvel Series}}</ref>
